summary_1line: Sacred prayers introduce the text, sages gather at Naimisa forest, and the chain of narrators begins leading to Nandi recounting Shiva’s story and Narada’s pride.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Suta descends among chanting sages in Naimisa forest as sacrificial smoke rises and morning light filters through the trees.
Markandeya beholds Shiva and Parvati seated on a moonstone altar on Mount Kailasa amid fragrant flowering trees.
Narada meditates beside Lake Manasarovar while celestial dancers attempt to distract him with music and dance.
